title: CLO 2025.0 - Rendering
description: This video will introduce the updates related to rendering features. Mac now supports GPU rendering, and the AI Model Workshop supports background generation, making the output process smoother. Other features will help you reduce rendering time.
transcript:
This video is to introduce functions related to rendering.  
In the previous version of the Mac system, only CPU rendering was supported.  
Now, the new version also supports GPU rendering.  
This allows Vray rendering speed to be faster even on Apple Silicon Macs.  
Let's use the test project file to check GPU rendering.  
First, open the rendering window.  
Then click on the rendering property icon.  
After the rendering settings appear,  
open the download menu under the rendering tool category.  
As you can see, there is a GPU option here.  
Now, let's run the actual rendering.  
You will see the result in the rendering window.  
Just like CPU rendering,  
GPU rendering supports all materials provided by Kolo,  
and the rendering speed is faster than before.  
This function requires installing the latest version of the updated SDK.  
If your SDK is not updated automatically,  
please be sure to manually install the latest version.  
Now, even on Mac,  
you can also install it  
and experience high-speed GPU rendering.  

In the new version,  
we can add different focal lengths for customized views.  
Open the rendering window,  
and change the current view under the video property  
to the customized view.  
Now we need to create a customized view.  
Open synchronized rendering  
to better set the customized view  
to the final desired position.  
After setting the user's customized view,  
under the lens property,  
open this actual camera only rendering  
and enable depth of field.  
We will change the current view to the customized view.  
You can see the customized view added in the list below.  
We also need to click on the setting focus point.  
Now, in the rendering window under synchronization,  
click the mouse button at the position you want to focus on.  
You can see the changes in the view under the lens  
in the property editor.  
Next, we use the same operation  
to set all the settings for the customized view.  
This new function can help us  
save a lot of time in rendering  
and better control the depth of each customized view  
in rendering,  
satisfying the rendering image we focus on.  

From the 2025 version,  
we can use AI-generated backgrounds  
and the rendering image in the hole  
to create a higher-quality rendering image  
easily.  
First of all,  
from the top menu,  
click on Rendering AI Model Workshop.  
In the window that appears,  
click on the background option in the upper right corner.  
You can use the background function.  
To use the background function of the AI Model Workshop,  
you first need to use the background conversion picture,  
which includes a transparent background image of virtual models and clothing.  
Please refer to the visual image displayed in the AI Model Workshop.  

We first need to change the background.  
Render the original picture first.  
Download the project file of the virtual model wearing the costume.  
Adjust the 3D window angle to the angle you want.  
Then click on Rendering in the top main menu.  
Open the rendering window.  
Start rendering the costume.  
To ensure that the original picture and the background picture generated or uploaded  
are smoothly and seamlessly integrated,  
we provide recommended picture size and rendering guidelines.  
To check these suggestions,  
first click on the magic wand icon in the rendering tool column on the right side.  
As you can see,  
under the original picture section,  
you can see the visual image and recommended settings.  
First of all, it is recommended to set the rendering picture size  
between 2160 pixels and 4320 pixels.  
If the rendering picture size is larger than 4320 pixels,  
it automatically adjusts the picture size to 4320 pixels or less,  
while maintaining a fixed ratio.  
If the picture size is set to 2160 pixels,  
it can still be used.  
But in order to get a better picture size  
and a more natural effect,  
it is best to use at least 2160 pixels for the picture,  
which offers fewer focal points and clear quality.  
Secondly, the main subject and background must be clear and distinguishable.  
If due to light or shadow  
the original picture cannot be correctly identified,  
the result may appear unnatural.  
The quality of the original picture  
will directly affect the final result,  
so please pay attention to this when rendering.  

Click on the picture video attribute.  
Because it will eventually generate a square  
with a background rendering picture,  
when setting the rendering size of the original picture,  
please pay attention  
to the pixel value of its picture size,  
which depends on the maximum value of the rendering size set in the original picture.  
If you set the original picture size to 2160 x 3840 pixels,  
the final output picture size will also be 3840 x 3840 pixels.  
According to the suggestion, after adjusting the settings,  
click on the final rendering to output high-quality images.  

Click on the AI Model Workshop again.  
You can see that the final rendering picture has been automatically uploaded.  
By switching between the AI Model Workshop window and the rendering window,  
you can immediately merge the background picture into the rendering picture,  
check the results, and adjust accordingly,  
achieving the final effect we want.  

Under the background selection in the AI Model Workshop,  
you can choose two methods:  
Proposal or Picture.  
For Proposal,  
you can enter the descriptive text you need  
or select keywords to generate a picture.  
For Picture,  
you can upload the picture file you like  
and use it as a background.  

Let's look at how to operate the prompt.  
You can enter the text needed to describe the background.  
You can also click on the first icon in the lower right corner of the box,  
Keyword Suggestion.  
Choose the words you need from the recommended keywords.  
When you choose the keywords here,  
they will be added to the text prompt section.  
For example, select "city street" and "industrial style."  
You will see these keywords automatically added to the prompt section.  
If you want to remove the selected keywords,  
you can click the X button on the right side of the prompt section,  
or in the keyword suggestion,  
click the selected keyword again  
to cancel its selection.  

After entering the prompt or selecting keywords,  
click on Start Generation next to it  
to generate a background picture.  
Press the Reset button at the bottom of the background picture  
to restore the generated background picture to default.  
By clicking on the result displayed after Start Generation,  
you can see that even if you use the same prompt,  
the AI Model Workshop function generates a new background picture every time.  

If you want to keep the existing picture  
and change the picture based on it,  
you can click on the icon shaped like a large second needle,  
Keep Keyword Input,  
then change the prompt content.  
If the prompt is not changed,  
or you add a new prompt,  
start generating a new background picture.  
For example, click on Keep Keyword Input  
and add the text prompt "bright"  
to make the background picture look brighter.  
Then click Start Generation.  
You can see that the newly generated background picture has been adjusted to be brighter  
while the original composition is still maintained.  

Finally, when you want to get creative inspiration from random background pictures,  
you can use the Random Generation function,  
which is the third dice icon.  
This function automatically generates random background description text,  
helping you quickly create creative ideas.  

If you want to write a prompt,  
you can click on the pencil icon in the upper right corner of the keyword prompt box.  
It clears the prompt to make it easier to rewrite the prompt,  
or you can use the keyword function to keep the input  
to make more detailed changes.  

Additionally, click on the question mark icon on the right side  
to visit the AI Model Workshop's handbook.  
Click on History Record,  
where you can see all previously generated picture charts.  
You can also double-click a picture to re-upload the picture and its corresponding text prompt.  
You can choose your favorite picture from the history record,  
then click the save icon in the upper right corner,  
saving it as a PNG file.  
You can also select all pictures and save all images.  
If pictures are not saved separately,  
these picture history records will only be kept until the software is closed.  

Next, select the Picture option,  
then click Upload  
to add the background picture we just created.  
However, please note when uploading pictures,  
you must use images with copyright or no copyright issues.  
After successfully adding the picture file,  
click at the bottom of the window to start creating  
and apply it to the original picture.  

If you want to redo the original picture and background picture,  
just click the Redo button next to Create,  
which restores to the default state.  

If you are satisfied with the result of the creation,  
you can click Save at the bottom of the window  
and choose to save the picture in PNG or JPG format.  
Please note that the final picture will be saved as a square,  
and the specific size depends on the original picture's picture video attribute,  
the maximum pixel value of the set picture size.  

If you first use AI to create a face picture in the face selection,  
and find defects in the hair or hands of the created person,  
you can use the three optimization functions in the output image window:  
hair optimization, hand optimization, and clothing optimization.  
Click on hair optimization and hand optimization for this picture,  
and you will see that the hair and hands of the final created picture  
have been optimized,  
improving the overall appearance.  

At this time, when applying the background to this picture  
and switching to the background option,  
the latest created face picture will be automatically set as the original picture  
to make your workflow more convenient.  
We will add the newly created face picture to the background  
and save it.  

By using the background generation function of the AI Model Workshop,  
you can easily create the clothes you designed  
and various background effects that match the virtual model.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - Rendering
chunks.content: # CLO 2025.0 - Rendering This document covers the rendering features in CLO 2025.0, focusing on CPU and GPU rendering, customized focal length views, and the AI Model Workshop for AI-generated backgrounds. It includes technical procedures, settings explanations, and optimization techniques for high-quality output. --- ## GPU Rendering Support on Mac (Apple Silicon) This section explains the new GPU rendering capabilities in CLO 2025.0 for Mac systems, providing faster Vray rendering speeds using Apple Silicon GPUs. - Previous Mac versions only supported CPU rendering. - CLO 2025.0 adds GPU rendering support, significantly increasing rendering speed on Apple Silicon Macs. - GPU rendering supports all Kolo-provided materials, identical in quality to CPU rendering but faster. - To use GPU rendering: - Open the rendering window. - Click the rendering property icon. - Under the rendering tool category, open the download menu. - Select the GPU option. - Start rendering and observe faster results in the rendering window. - Requires the latest SDK version; if not updated automatically, manual installation is necessary. - GPU rendering is now accessible on Mac, enabling high-speed rendering workflows. --- ## Customized Views with Different Focal Lengths This section details how to create and manage customized camera views with adjustable focal lengths and depth of field control for more precise rendering composition. - New in CLO 2025.0: Add multiple focal lengths for customized views. - Procedure: 1. Open the rendering window. 2. Change the current view under video properties to "Customized View." 3. Create and position the customized view using synchronized rendering to match the desired final framing. 4. Enable "Actual Camera Only Rendering" under the lens property. 5. Activate depth of field (DoF) to control focus effects. 6. Set focus points by clicking desired areas in the rendering window under synchronization. 7. Adjust all settings similarly for other customized views. - Benefits: - Saves time by reusing preset views. - Provides better depth control per view. - Improves control over rendering composition focused on key image areas. --- ## AI-Generated Backgrounds with the AI Model Workshop This section introduces the AI Model Workshop for generating and applying AI-based backgrounds to virtual model renderings, including setup, prompt usage, and image optimization. ### Accessing AI Model Workshop and Background Function - Open from the top menu: Rendering > AI Model Workshop. - Select the "Background" option in the upper right corner. - Prerequisite: Use background conversion images with transparent backgrounds of virtual models and clothing. - Start by rendering the original picture of the virtual model in costume. - Recommended rendering picture size: 2160 to 4320 pixels width/height. - Larger than 4320 pixels automatically scales down to maintain ratio. - Minimum 2160 pixels recommended for quality and natural effect. - Ensure the main subject and background are clearly distinguishable to avoid unnatural results caused by shadows or lighting. - Check recommended settings by clicking the magic wand icon in the rendering tool column. ### Picture Size and Aspect Ratio Considerations - Background generation requires square output.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.0 - Rendering
chunks.content: - Recommended rendering picture size: 2160 to 4320 pixels width/height. - Larger than 4320 pixels automatically scales down to maintain ratio. - Minimum 2160 pixels recommended for quality and natural effect. - Ensure the main subject and background are clearly distinguishable to avoid unnatural results caused by shadows or lighting. - Check recommended settings by clicking the magic wand icon in the rendering tool column. ### Picture Size and Aspect Ratio Considerations - Background generation requires square output. - Final output size’s width and height equal the maximum pixel dimension of original rendering size. - Example: Original picture at 2160 x 3840 pixels outputs a 3840 x 3840 pixel square image. - Adjust settings accordingly before final rendering for high-quality images. ### Background Selection Methods - **Proposal**: Enter descriptive text prompts or select keywords to generate AI backgrounds. - **Picture**: Upload your own image files as backgrounds. - Use the top menu to switch between these options. ### Using Text Prompts and Keyword Suggestions - Enter text describing background elements. - Use the "Keyword Suggestion" icon to select relevant keywords (e.g., "city street," "industrial style"). - Keywords are appended to the prompt and can be removed by clicking an X next to them. - Click "Start Generation" to create backgrounds. - The "Reset" button restores the background to default. - Each generation with the same prompt produces a unique background. ### Keyword Input Management - Use the "Keep Keyword Input" icon (large second needle icon) to preserve keywords between generations. - Modify or add new prompts for iterative background refinement. - Example: Adding "bright" to the prompt brightens the generated background while maintaining composition. ### Random Generation and Prompt Editing - The dice icon triggers "Random Generation," producing random background prompts for creative inspiration. - The pencil icon clears the prompt box for easier rewriting. - The question mark icon links to the AI Model Workshop handbook for detailed guidance. ### History and Saving of Generated Backgrounds - Access "History Record" to review all generated backgrounds and prompts. - Double-click images to re-upload with their original prompts. - Save individual or all images as PNG files. - Unsaved history is lost when the software closes. ### Uploading Custom Background Pictures - Upload background images via the "Picture" option. - Ensure images have appropriate copyright status. - After upload, click "Create" to merge with the original picture. - Use "Redo" to restore the original state if needed. - Save final images as PNG or JPG, saved as squares sized according to original picture settings. --- ## AI Face Picture Optimization and Integration This section covers the optimization tools for AI-generated face pictures and their integration into background rendering workflows. - When creating AI-generated faces, defects may appear in hair or hands. - CLO 2025.0 provides three optimization functions: - Hair Optimization - Hand Optimization - Clothing Optimization - Apply hair and hand optimization to improve details and overall appearance.

These features enhance rendering speed, compositional control, and creative flexibility, supported by detailed procedures and optimization tools for professional-quality virtual model visuals.
